highlights.description: More accurate cross-framework normalization and safer score/level lookups

breaking.description: `Normalize()`, `CompareAcross()`, and `MapTo()` now spread levels across the full range using index/(total-1); odd-level frameworks such as Severity and Priority map to different normalized buckets than before — re-check any persisted or compared normalization results

added.description: `LevelCounts.Valid()` reports whether a level ID exists in the associated framework
`ErrNilFramework` and `ErrUnknownLevel` sentinel errors returned by `ScoreRange.LevelFromScore()`

fixed.description: `ScoreRange.LevelFromScore()` no longer panics when `Framework` is nil and now surfaces an unrecognized level ID as `ErrUnknownLevel` instead of returning a nil level with no error
`MapTo()` returns a pointer to the destination slice element instead of a loop-local copy, matching `Parse()`

tests.description: Add tests for normalization distribution, `LevelCounts.Valid()`, and the new `ScoreRange` error paths

build.description: Require Go 1.25 to match the org toolchain standard

highlights.description: Score-to-level mapping with built-in CVSS support, and level counting for dashboards and reports
IETF RFC 2119 split into requirements (MUST/SHOULD/MAY) and prohibitions (MUST NOT/SHOULD NOT) frameworks

breaking.description: `IETF()` now returns only MUST, SHOULD, MAY levels; use `IETFProhibitions()` for MUST NOT, SHOULD NOT

added.description: `ScoreRange` type for mapping numeric score ranges to framework levels
`CVSSScoreRange()` built-in for CVSS v3 scores (0-10) to Severity levels
`PercentageScoreRange()` for percentage-based level mapping
`LevelFromScore()` and `MustLevelFromScore()` methods
`LevelCounts` type for tracking item counts per priority level
`Total()`, `ActionableTotal()`, `HigherThan()`, `LowerThan()` count aggregations
`Merge()`, `Clone()`, `Reset()` for combining and managing counts
`Slice()` returns counts in framework level order
`IETFProhibitions()` framework for compliance validation (MUST NOT, SHOULD NOT)

changed.description: `IETF()` simplified to 3 levels (MUST, SHOULD, MAY) for prioritization

tests.description: Comprehensive tests for ScoreRange and LevelCounts

documentation.description: Clarify action-oriented level ordering in README (items to implement before items to avoid)
Document IETF/IETFProhibitions split for requirements vs compliance

highlights.description: Go library for standardized priority level definitions with 5 built-in frameworks and cross-framework normalization

added.description: Core `Framework` and `Level` types for defining priority systems
Built-in `Severity` framework (Critical, High, Medium, Low, Info)
Built-in `Priority` framework (P0-P4 urgency levels)
Built-in `IETF` framework (RFC 2119 requirement levels: MUST, SHOULD, MAY)
Built-in `MoSCoW` framework (Must Have, Should Have, Could Have, Won't Have)
Built-in `General` framework (High, Medium, Low)
`Normalize()` function for converting levels to comparable numeric scale (0-100)
`CompareAcross()` function for comparing priorities across different frameworks
`MapTo()` function for finding equivalent levels between frameworks
`GetLevelByID()` and `GetLevelByNameOrAlias()` lookup functions

tests.description: Unit tests for framework lookups, normalization, and cross-framework comparison

documentation.description: README with installation, usage examples, and API documentation
Badge shields for CI, Go Report Card, and license
Contributing section with link to CHANGELOG

build.description: GitHub Actions CI workflows for testing, linting, and CodeQL
Dependabot configuration for automated dependency updates
golangci-lint configuration with gosec, staticcheck, and other linters
